THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
6 · Redbrand confrontation · optional
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

Four people in dirty red cloaks drift into your path. One plants a boot on the boardwalk. Another watches the townsfolk make room without being asked. The first says, “Visitors usually learn how things work here before asking questions.” What do you do?

Their attention gives the encounter an immediate edge, but the street still offers space to speak or withdraw. Before anyone reaches for a weapon, you can look at where the strangers stand and decide whether to answer together, keep your distance, or let one person do the talking.

Ask the players

Do you answer, leave, seek help, bargain, or fight? Where is everyone standing?

Choices

The party can de-escalate, retreat, capture, or fight. If they avoid the gang, let consequences develop later.
